content: Statement frozen 14 days before any proof attempt; witness-size bound and product-preservation conclusion both preregistered, with the two-element case declared the only admissible short certificate.
Proof manuscript (9 pp.): lemma chain (L1 embedding reduction, L2 canonical-diagram collapse, L3 two-element normal form). Each lemma carries an explicit certificate obligation.
Independent mechanical certificate checker run C-2211: all 3 lemma obligations discharged, 412 proof steps, 0 gaps, checker hash 6f9c..., exit 0, run on an unmodified public checker build.
Classical quasivariety preservation theorem (donor D-K): gives the products direction for universal classes only; does not give the two-element witness bound.
Negative control: the analogous statement for the restricted fragment Q' is known false; the manuscript's L2 step is shown to fail for Q' exactly where the witness grows.
Value, bound family, and n>=7 restriction frozen before construction; the 2n-2 case declared in advance as the falsifier of any careless induction.
Matching construction: explicit family attaining 2n-3 with a verifiable witness listing for n=7..12 (41, 82, 155, 293, 551, 1036 witnesses).
Machine verification of all six witness listings against the parameter definition: 6/6 pass, exhaustive for n=7 (state space 2^18 enumerated), certificate 88 KB.
Donor D-A: general upper bound 2n-1 by a greedy argument; no exact value known there.
Independent re-derivation of the upper bound by a second method (LP relaxation of the covering formulation) agrees at 2n-3 for n=7..12.
Both directions preregistered; the 'only if' direction declared the risky half.
Proof (6 pp.): forward direction by a compactness transfer; reverse by an explicit finite table construction with a rank function bounded by 2^k.
Certificate checker run C-2277: 2 obligations, 0 gaps; the rank-bound lemma machine-verified for k<=4 and proven generally in the text.
Donor D-M: proves the forward direction for varieties; the finite-table reverse direction and the complement closure formulation are absent there.
Counterexample search over 2,341 small structures of size<=6: 0 violations found, consistent with the theorem.
The two failure coordinates and the linear-time budget frozen before construction.
Two explicit reductions R1, R2 with composed identity checked on normal forms; the composition is shown to be the identity up to renaming.
Round-trip property machine-checked on 10,000 generated normal forms: 10,000/10,000 fixed, max reduction depth 3, checker exit 0.
Donor D-T: states the two coordinates as separately measurable but gives no reduction either way.
A third coordinate (failure-by-noncompactness) is shown NOT to reduce to the other two; the claimed duality correctly excludes it.
Both the NL upper bound and a hardness reduction were preregistered as necessary; either alone declared insufficient at freeze time.
Upper bound: deterministic logarithmic-space certifier with one-way certificate tape. Hardness: log-space reduction from directed reachability with 3-gadget local replacement.
Certifier implemented and run over 5,000 generated instances: all accepted instances verified by an independent brute-force decider (n<=18), 0 disagreements; gadget replacement checked edge-locally.
Donor D-R: P membership via a different dynamic program; no completeness claim.
The unrestricted fragment (mixed + transitive closure) is shown to retain its known hardness; the NL result does not leak upward.
Transfer statement frozen; novelty of the mechanism declared the claim to be evaluated.
Proof (3 pp.): ultraproduct construction plus a Los-style transfer step for the finite signature set.
Internal review notes the proof is correct.
Donor D-B (classical, predating the programme by decades): compactness plus the Los lemma give exactly this transfer for arbitrary signature sets; the finite restriction is a special case.
A citable textbook statement (donor D-B, ch. 4) contains the claim verbatim for the more general case.
Characterisation statement frozen.
Proof (4 pp.) of both inclusions via Moore-closure composition.
Both inclusions verified on 3 example lattices (M3, N5, and a 32-element lattice).
Donor D-C: HSP-style theorem already characterises the same closed sets as the subalgebra-closure of a generating family; the meet-chain condition is a re-expression.
Invariant definition and monotonicity statement frozen.
Definition of I(G) plus a monotonicity proof by induction on rule additions.
Monotonicity checked computationally on 240 random systems of size<=9: 240/240 monotone.
Donor D-G: the degree invariant of a related basis (the 'height polynomial') is pointwise equal to I(G) on all 240 systems and its monotonicity is classical.
The two invariants were compared only after both were defined; comparison code is independent.
Operator definition frozen.
The operator is defined as the composition of two classical closure operators with an idempotence proof.
Idempotence verified on 512 sampled sets.
Donor D-H: composition closure of Moore families is classical; the exact composed operator appears as an exercise with solution.
The interpolation constant and fragment frozen.
Construction showing 3n labels always suffice, with a 2n lower-bound example.
Sufficiency machine-checked on generated formulas up to depth 6.
Donor D-J: a quantitative Craig-style interpolation theorem for the same fragment already yields 3n exactly; the lower-bound example also appears there.
Four-arm design frozen: {none, T1, O2, T1+O2}; interaction declared the estimand, not the marginal.

Mean certificate length over 1,000 held-out instances: none 412.3, T1-only 409.1 (-0.8%, bootstrap CI [-2.1, +0.6], includes 0), O2-only 411.0 (-0.3%, CI [-1.8, +1.2], includes 0), T1+O2 355.6 (-13.7%, CI [-15.9, -11.4], excludes 0).
Shuffle-null with equal arm sizes: interaction effect 0.0 +- 0.9% (z=15.2 for the observed).
Neither component's mechanism alone predicts the compression; the gain arises from O2 exploiting a block structure that only T1 exposes.
Two-by-two factorial frozen; depth reduction declared the estimand.
Median search depth on 400 problems: none 88, R3-only 87 (p=0.71), L4-only 88 (p=0.83), R3+L4 61 (p<1e-6, paired).
On a problem class without lemma structure, the combination shows no gain (median 92 vs 92, p=0.44), locating the interaction in the lemma structure.
Parent theorem reproduction and the strengthening declared separately at freeze; the strengthening requires a super-constant speedup on the standard witness family.

New proof of the parent theorem verified (all 4 obligations). Strengthening: measured speedup on the witness family is 1.04x-1.11x across n=2^8..2^16, best-fit exponent difference 0.013 (CI [-0.031, +0.057], includes 0).
Any-constant-factor null declared the falsifier at freeze; observed factors sit inside the constant regime.
The parent theorem itself is not in question; only the claimed strengthening is.
Parent formula re-validated and the refinement's interaction term preregistered with a minimum detectable effect of 5%.
Parent formula re-validated on 10,000 fresh samples (0 violations). Refinement: fitted interaction coefficient 0.0004 (CI [-0.0021, +0.0029], includes 0); the predicted 7-9% interaction is excluded.
Power check: the design detects the preregistered 5% effect with probability 0.94; the null is informative, not underpowered.
Conjecture frozen; a single explicit counterexample declared sufficient to close it negative.
Construction of an infinite antichain A_1 < A_2 < ... of P-definable, substructure-closed structures whose union is not finitely axiomatisable; the first three members written out.
The antichain property machine-verified for the first 6 members (certificate 14 KB, checker exit 0); the general construction is proven in the text.
The conjecture had been used as an assumption in two downstream notes; both are marked affected and their conclusions withdrawn in the same record.
FPT claim frozen with an explicit algorithm-or-reduction obligation.
The sketch's branching step is shown to require exploring Omega(n^k) configurations: a family of instances where every branch differs.
Reduction from k-Clique: 5-gadget local replacement, verified edge-locally on generated instances (1,000/1,000 correct); under the standard assumption this closes the claim negative.
The reduction composed with a known solver preserves solution correspondence exactly.
Decidability claim frozen; undecidability declared the closing route.
Reduction from the tiling problem: configurations encoded as elements, tiling constraints as a two-formula scheme in the fragment.
The two formulas verified to enforce horizontal and vertical tiling on 512 random 6x6 grids (512/512 forced-correct); the reduction is proven in the text.
A prior decidability sketch relied on a finite-model property that the transitive predicate destroys; the destruction is exhibited explicitly.
Benchmark construction code and labels frozen before any method comparison.
Reported: new method 96.7% vs strongest public baseline 61.3%.
Post-hoc audit artifact: a degenerate invariant (parity of the generator count) classifies 294/300 instances exactly; a trivial parity-only classifier scores 98.0%.
The suite's generator drew instances from two disjoint families with parity-aligned labels, so label information is recoverable without any algebra.
Checker version frozen; claims submitted for verification.
Checker output: 4,317/4,317 claims accepted.
Adversarial probe: an empty-conjunction witness (vacuously true obligation set) and a circularly-defined obligation are both ACCEPTED by the same checker version (probe transcript attached).
The checker's acceptance path does not require the witness to mention the goal formula.
Working foundations frozen; any dependence outside them declared a non-identifiability.
The proof's key lemma is shown equivalent (in both directions) to a weak choice principle known to be independent of the frozen foundations; both the derivation and its converse are given.
With the principle added, the law holds; with its negation, a countermodel exists. Both constructions written out and checked.
A restricted version of the law provable without the principle is isolated and holds unconditionally.
Freeze requires every external appeal to carry a checkable statement plus proof or certificate.
The submitted proof cites 'Lemma W (external manuscript)' at its central step; the citation gives no statement text.
No artifact in the supplied evidence states Lemma W's content; a proof search over the visible corpus returns no candidate statement.
Two candidate readings of the missing lemma are exhibited; one makes the theorem true, the other false - so the visible evidence cannot discriminate.
Longitudinal design frozen: the same claim is to be re-evaluated under a preregistered budget escalation; a round-2 regime change is scheduled.
Round 1 (budget: depth 100, 10^5 instances): 0 counterexamples; depth-100 exhaustion certificate 22 MB.
Instrumentation check: the generator's coverage of deep witnesses is confirmed at shallow depths by seeding 50 known counterexamples of depth<=40 (50/50 found).
The conjecture's failure modes, if any, are predicted to live at depth >= 300 by the round-1 analysis itself.
Round-2 budget (depth 400, 10^7 instances) frozen in the same document as round 1, before either round ran.
Round 2: counterexample found at depth 317 (instance I-317-44, witness 2.1 KB, independently re-verified by the frozen checker; exit 0).
Round 1's certificate remains valid for its scope: the exhaustion is real but its scope was depth<=100.
The depth-317 instance re-run under the round-1 budget confirms it is outside that budget's search space (not reachable in 10^5 draws, seed scan attached).
Task, split, metric, and both representations frozen; the same-information constraint (byte-identical underlying data) declared the load-bearing condition.

Held-out skill: baseline representation 0.0239 (95% CI [0.0211, 0.0267]); changed representation 0.0352 (CI [0.0318, 0.0386]); paired difference +0.0113 (CI [0.0081, 0.0145], excludes 0). 12 seeds, predeclared.

Causal diagnostic: intervention on the representation component alone moves the mechanism probe from 0.2 to 0.8 (preregistered threshold 0.5); the probe is inert under placebo intervention (0.2 -> 0.2).
Shuffle-null at matched sample size: difference 0.0001 (CI [-0.0026, +0.0028]).

Donor E-1 (representation-theorem programme): predicts representational gains are possible without new information but gives no task-level construction; the delta here is the construction plus the causal diagnostic.
The 0.965 requirement, the protected baseline, and the steering rule frozen before any steering run; metric drift declared the falsifier.
Steered runs: 0.9721 mean over 40 episodes (CI [0.9694, 0.9748], lower bound above 0.965). Protected baseline replication: 0.9556 (CI [0.9519, 0.9593], upper bound below 0.965).
Metric-drift audit: a held-out metric battery (7 independent checks) is unchanged (max |delta| 0.0009); the probe target itself is not part of the evaluated metric.
The baseline's shortfall was previously attributed to capacity; the steering result refutes that attribution (capacity unchanged between arms).
Coverage floor (60%), abstention budget, and scoring rule frozen.
Policy with abstention: Brier 0.0812 at coverage 63.4%; no-abstention baseline: Brier 0.1105 at coverage 100%. Difference -0.0293 (bootstrap CI [-0.0361, -0.0227], 10,000 resamples, excludes 0).
Random-abstention control at matched coverage 63.4%: Brier 0.1091 (no improvement; CI [-0.0041, +0.0033] vs baseline, includes 0) - selectivity, not abstention, carries the gain.
Donor E-2: abstention frameworks for classification; the delta is the coverage-floor calibration accounting and the random-abstention control.
Estimator and benchmark frozen; novelty of the mechanism declared the estimand.
Variance reduction 27.3% (CI [24.1, 30.2]) across 8 benchmark distributions.

Donor E-3: control-variate estimation with a known bounding-function control achieves the same algebra; the proposed estimator is the control-variate estimator with the control written in expanded form (identity verified symbolically and on all 8 benchmarks to 1e-12).
Step-by-step algebraic rewrite from the donor form to the proposed form is included and machine-checked.
Scheme frozen with a target coverage of 95% two-sided.
Empirical coverage 94.8% across 6 simulated families.
Donor E-4: the double-bootstrap bias-corrected interval (decades old) instantiates exactly; the first stage is the calibrated root, the second the correction, with identical tuning constants.
Score definition and stability comparison frozen.
Rank-stability 0.81 vs 0.27 for the baseline under resampling (1,000 resamples).

Donor E-5: rank-stability under bootstrap resampling is an established measurement; the proposed score is Kendall-tau stability with a monotone transform (Spearman footrule identity verified on all 1,000 resample pairs).
Rule frozen; comparison against fixed-epoch and fixed-patience baselines.
Mean final dev loss 0.412 vs 0.431 (patience-3) and 0.447 (fixed) over 15 tasks.
Donor E-6: rank-correlation-based generalisation stopping appears in an established model-selection treatment with the same 0.9 trigger; the present rule matches it in all tunable constants.
Four-arm factorial frozen; interaction declared the estimand.
Expected calibration error: none 0.061, schedule-only 0.059 (CI [-0.006,+0.010] vs none), constraint-only 0.060 (CI [-0.005,+0.007]), combination 0.038 (CI [-0.028,-0.018]).
On single-domain batches the combination's gain vanishes (0.059 vs 0.060), locating the interaction in cross-domain mixture structure.
Two-by-two design frozen.
Shuffle-null at matched sizes: combined-vs-none difference 0.0 +- 0.8.
Two-by-two design frozen; sample-to-threshold declared the estimand.
Episodes to 90% return: none 412, replay-only 401 (p=0.42), freeze-only 408 (p=0.67), combined 268 (p<1e-4).
Ablating the freeze-schedule's second phase removes most of the combined gain (361 vs 268, p=0.003), identifying the specific co-dependence.
Parent effect and the extension declared separately; minimum detectable effect set at one-third of the parent's magnitude.

Parent replication: -0.0021 (CI [-0.0029,-0.0013]), consistent with the parent record. Extension domain: -0.00016 (CI [-0.00031,+0.00002], includes 0); the preregistered minimum detectable effect is excluded.
Power: 0.91 for the preregistered effect; the null is informative.
The extension used identical code paths and the same seeds as the parent; only the data source changed.
Second-family transfer declared a separate claim with its own threshold (+0.005).
Parent reproduction: +0.0110 (CI [+0.0078,+0.0142]). Second family: +0.0004 (CI [-0.0034,+0.0042], includes 0); preregistered +0.005 excluded.
Diagnostic probe: the mechanism activated by the representation change is absent in the second family (probe 0.21 vs 0.79 in the parent domain), giving a mechanism-level explanation of the null.
Curvature term preregistered with minimum detectable curvature 0.05 per doubling.
Parent log-linear fit reproduced (slope 0.987 vs parent 0.991, CI overlaps). Curvature: 0.004 per doubling (CI [-0.009,+0.017], includes 0); preregistered 0.05 excluded.
A synthetic positive-control with injected curvature 0.06 is recovered at 0.058 (CI [0.041,0.075]), so the null is not a measurement failure.
The 90% floor declared a separate regime with the same estimand.
Parent regime (60% floor) reproduced: -0.0289 (CI [-0.0356,-0.0223]). Strict regime (90% floor): -0.0031 (CI [-0.0068,+0.0006], includes 0).
Coverage 91.2% in the strict regime; abstention budget nearly exhausted, so the mechanism has no room to act - the null is regime-structural, not noise.
Three-size sweep (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B) frozen with per-size gates and a family-level bootstrap lower-bound requirement.

0.5B: -0.140625 (large negative, CI [-0.152,-0.129]). 1.5B: 0.0000 (CI [-0.006,+0.006], includes 0). 3B: +0.0031 (CI [+0.0002,+0.0060], excludes 0 but below the preregistered 0.01 gate). Family-level bootstrap lower bound <= 0.
Training diagnostics: the modification destabilises the 0.5B runs (loss spikes in 8/10 seeds), identified as the mechanism of the negative.
A revival lever (gradient-clip schedule) is documented as the follow-up, not as a reason to withhold the negative.
Cost model (7% round-trip taker, maker exempt, spread 1 tick, 1-tick slippage per side) frozen; the clean-parent comparison declared the only admissible test.

Claimed (no costs, signal-bar fills): +2.14 per unit. Measured (realistic fills, whole chain): -0.31 per unit (CI [-0.44,-0.18]); passive-fill probability 0.62 implies the survivorship of the claimed edge is fully explained by fill selection.
Shuffle-equal-n null: -0.29 (CI [-0.38,-0.20]) - the rule is indistinguishable from random selection at the same trade count.
Detection-delay ratio <= 0.5 at matched false-alarm rate frozen as the gate.
Measured ratio 1.38 (detector is 38% LATER); at every operating point on the ROC the detector is dominated or matched (max advantage -4%).
A synthetic injected-shift battery recovers the gate for a known-shift class (ratio 0.41), so the negative is specific to the natural-shift corpus, and is retained with that boundary stated.
Retirement record with three named defects frozen (task ceiling reached by both arms; leaked holdout key in the scoring join; label duplication across folds).
Post-repair re-run on a validated instrument: difference +0.1 points (CI [-1.3,+1.5], includes 0).
Each defect's contribution is isolated: ceiling alone reduces the gap to +3.1; adding the leak repair reduces to +0.4; dedup to +0.1.
The retirement was recorded before the re-run; the earlier +9.6 remains in the archive as evidence about the instrument, not the methods.
Split identities and cache paths frozen; cache-identity audit preregistered.
Overlap audit: 38% of holdout rows carry tuned preprocessing state. Post-purge re-run (fresh cache, no shared state): 76% vs 74% (CI of the difference includes 0).
A deliberately-overlapping positive control reproduces the inflation mechanism exactly (91% -> 76% under purge), certifying the diagnosis.
Green defined as conclusion=success on the head commit; display-level summaries declared inadmissible at freeze.

The offered summary lists 6 jobs as failed; the run-level records show those 6 as cancelled-by-upstream-restart with conclusion=cancelled, and a later rerun on the same head reaches conclusion=success for all 6.
A summary-to-record consistency check over 1,000 runs finds display failure labels with conclusion=cancelled in 7.1% of rows - the display is a known lossy channel.
No claim about the system's content is at stake; the question is what the evidence channel can support.
Identifiability from checkpoints declared the estimand; run logs sealed.
An explicit construction: two run trajectories from different knob settings produce byte-identical final checkpoints (loss curves differ only in removed auxiliary fields).
The construction is verified over 50 seeded pairs: 50/50 byte-identical checkpoints from different knob values; the checkpoint format provably discards the discriminating trace.
With run logs unsealed, the knob is trivially readable - identifiability fails exactly at the checkpoint granularity and nowhere else.
Freeze requires the evaluation set, or its full construction recipe, to be present for any claim that depends on it.
The submitted report references set S-protected (digested 4d21...) with construction omitted for privacy; no recipe, split, or size is given.
A reconstruction attempt from the visible corpus yields 3 candidate sets with fairness deltas of +0.011, -0.004, and +0.019 - the claim's sign is not stable across candidates.
The digest is verifiable once an authorized party reveals the set; the channel for that is external to this evidence.
Longitudinal design frozen: rounds at budgets 32 and 128 preregistered; no terminal action permitted on round-1 evidence alone.
Round 1 (budget 32): best score 0.61 (CI [0.57,0.65]); trend versus budget-16 pilot (0.55) is positive but the pilot was not preregistered.
Instrumentation check: budget accounting verified (32.0 +- 0.0 units consumed).
The round-2 budget escalation is scheduled and its protocol is already frozen.
Round-2 budget 128 frozen with round 1; same seeds, same scoring, preregistered success gate (>= 0.70 at budget 128).

Round 2: best score 0.58 (CI [0.55,0.61]); the 0.70 gate is excluded. Budget-accounting verified (128.0 +- 0.0). The budget-32 optimum is not revisited - the search collapses to a different basin (trace attached).
A held-out basin classifier confirms the round-2 basin differs from round-1 (assignment 0.94 posterior).
The trend reversal is a regime change under the frozen longitudinal protocol; the claim's record must be amended with both rounds, and the mechanism question reopened.
Format frozen (per-record content hashes, chained digests, run-id binding) before any attack attempt; the attack battery was preregistered.

Attack battery, 11 preregistered mutation classes (field edit, record swap, timestamp shift, digest reuse, truncated tail, replayed record, cross-run splice, hash collision attempt via truncation, header rewrite, signature strip, wholesale file replace): 11/11 detected; detection is by chain break in 9 and by run-id mismatch in 2.
Negative control: 10,000 unmutated chains verified clean (0 false detections).
Donor I-1 (transparency-log lineage): owns the chained-digest mechanism; the delta is the evaluation-record binding and the preregistered mutation battery.
Gate frozen: regenerate into a scratch directory and byte-compare against the committed artifacts; any byte difference fails.

Executed on 3 machine profiles (two OS families, two filesystems): 3/3 byte-identical; the artifacts total 4.1 MB across 3 files; a deliberate 1-byte flip in the committed copy is caught (gate exit 1).
Positive-detection control: 20 seeded single-byte flips, 20/20 caught.
Donor I-2 (reproducible-build practice): owns determinism discipline; the delta is the evaluation-artifact application and the flip-control battery.
Checker frozen with its forbidden-field list and marker strings; mutation testing preregistered as the acceptance route.
Mutation battery: 24 single-concept mutations (allow additionalProperties, add a forbidden field, drop an enum value, widen a type, remove a marker string, weaken a minimum): 24/24 caught (exit 1).
Unmutated contract passes (exit 0); a minimal packet fixture passes while carrying only a digest of hidden gold.
The checker prints a distinct success string; absence of output is treated as failure by the surrounding gate.
Scheme frozen; novelty of the mechanism declared the estimand.
Scheme implemented; 1,200 artifacts named; collision-free as expected.
Donor I-3: content-addressed storage (git, and decades of Merkle-lineage systems) owns the mechanism exactly; the canonicalisation choice is documented there too.
A line-by-line mapping from the donor's scheme to the proposed one is included.
Funnel frozen with its gate list.
Funnel operated for 6 weeks; 41 candidates processed; no threshold loosened.
Donor I-4: ratcheting acceptance pipelines in release engineering own the mechanism (never-loosen thresholds, gated promotion); the mapping is direct.
Worksheet design frozen.
Pilot with 4 evaluators; identity-recovery rate 0/4 below chance.
Donor I-5: blinded adjudication in clinical-trials and measurement practice owns the mechanism; the identity-stripping checklist maps item-for-item.
Four-arm build-latency design frozen (median over 30 cold builds per arm).
Median minutes: none 41.2, cache-only 40.8 (-1.0%, CI [-4,+2]%), fusion-only 40.9 (-0.7%, CI [-3,+2]%), combination 28.4 (-31.1%, CI [-34,-28]%).
When cache keys are coarsened (defeating exact-address reuse), the combination's gain shrinks to -3% - the fusion benefit requires exact cache identity.
Two-by-two design frozen; stuck-run rate declared the estimand.
Stuck runs per 1,000: none 8.1, queue-only 7.9 (p=0.86), checkpoint-only 8.0 (p=0.91), combined 1.2 (p<1e-4).
With checkpoints disabled entirely the combined gain disappears (7.8 per 1,000): the lock-free queue only helps when recovery is cheap.
Parent reclaim (0.41 of store bytes) and the extension declared separately; minimum detectable fraction 0.20.
Parent store re-audited: 0.40 reclaimed, matches. Second store: 0.03 reclaimed (CI [0.01,0.05]); the 0.20 minimum detectable effect is excluded.
A synthetic duplicate-injection control recovers injected duplicates at 0.97 efficiency on the second store, so the null is about content, not tooling.
Misclassification rate threshold (halving) frozen for the second dashboard.
Parent dashboard: rate 7.1% -> 0.9% (reproduced). Second dashboard: 6.8% -> 6.5% (CI [-1.7,+2.3] points, includes 0).
The second dashboard renders raw status text with no display summarisation layer; the parent fix has no surface to act on there - the null is structural.
Transfer gate frozen: >= 80% detection on injected config drift.
Parent (contract schemas): 20/20 injected drifts caught (reproduced). Configs: 9/20 (45%); the gate is excluded.
Missed cases share one cause (comment-only reformatting is legitimate drift-free change), giving a mechanism-level boundary: hash-detection transfers to content formats, not comment-bearing ones.
Paper-trading forensic preregistered as the only admissible evidence for the widening; backtest-overfit gate (probability of backtest overfitting) frozen.

Backtest claims +85.8/day. Probability of backtest overfitting = 1.0 across the configuration grid (every neighbouring configuration beats it - the selected point is the grid's luckiest). Paper-trading forensic: the fillable additions realise -5.63 per share (n=54 fills, CI [-7.41,-3.85]); the claimed sign is inverted in live paper fills.
Failure attribution: 11/18 losses occur in the widened segment specifically; early-window reversal is the mechanism.
The un-widened rule remains positive in the same forensic (+2.06 per share); the negative attaches to the widening only, and is retained.
Time-to-detection gate (<= 50% of the incumbent monitor at matched false-alarm rate) frozen; a decomposed false-alarm audit preregistered.

Measured ratio 1.9 (nearly twice as slow); the decomposed audit shows the monitor's stand-down channel fires on 3 transient patterns, masking real decay until it is asymptotic - the failure is structural to the transient filter, not tuning.
Disabling the transient filter restores ratio 0.61 (gate met) but raises false alarms above the matched budget; both operating points are reported.
Cost gate (<= 1.2x manual spend) and throughput gate (>= +10%) frozen.

Measured spend ratio 3.4x (gate excluded); throughput +2.1% (CI [-1.2,+5.4], includes 0). The agent's retry loop re-enumerates unchanged state after each rejection, accounting for 71% of spend (trace accounting attached).
A memoisation patch for the re-enumeration drops spend to 1.8x with throughput +1.9% - documented as the revival lever, not deployed as a pass.
Metric definitions frozen with version stamps; unstamped redefinition declared a corruption.
Version audit: 9/12 submetrics changed definition between the two measurement dates; under fixed definitions the change is +1 (CI [-3,+5], includes 0).
Recompute with the old definitions on new data and new definitions on old data (2x2 definitional control): only the new-on-new cell shows the gain, confirming definitional drift as the mechanism.
Silent-failure scan preregistered: any absence claim must carry a counted search with stated scope.

The offered study makes 6 absence claims from empty outputs; recounting with exit codes and numeric tallies: 4 of 6 are false absences (the outputs were swallowed by display filters; counted lines are non-zero).
A known-present target planted in the corpus is recovered by the counted method (1/1) and missed by the naive method (0/1), certifying the diagnosis.
Enforcement vs logging declared distinguishable only by a preregistered probe (attempt a violating action under observation), not by reading logs.

Construction: for the logged-only configuration, the probe action appears in the log AND is executed; for the enforced configuration it appears AND is refused. Both traces supplied. The offered evidence contains logs from a configuration that cannot be determined from the logs themselves.
The supplied log lines are byte-compatible with both configurations (50 such pairs exhibited); post-hoc logs cannot identify which ran.
The probe distinguishes the configurations in 20/20 trials when it is permitted.
Freeze requires the contemporaneous manifest for any sharing claim; regenerated manifests declared non-evidentiary.
The manifest in the record post-dates the deployment under question (regeneration timestamp); the contemporaneous file was not preserved.
Reconstruction from deploy logs yields 2 candidate manifest states with different shared-state answers; the visible evidence cannot discriminate.
A preserved-manifest positive control from a comparable deployment resolves its question exactly, showing what the missing artifact would have settled.
Longitudinal design frozen: a recovery round is scheduled in which a read-only archive tap is attempted under a changed attach protocol; round-1 'unarchivable' is scoped to the round-1 protocol.
Round 1 (attach protocol v1): 3/3 attach attempts drop the live consumer within 60s; the failure trace is captured.
Instrumentation: the drop is caused by backpressure on a shared buffer (trace shows buffer overflow at attach), a protocol-level mechanism, not data-level.
The round-2 protocol change (read-only tap with its own buffer) is frozen in the same document.
Round-2 tap protocol (independent buffer, no backpressure coupling) frozen with round 1 before either ran.
Round 2: tap attached for 6 consecutive hours, 0 drops, 2.3 GB recovered, checksum match against the consumer's own offsets for the overlap window (0 mismatches over 41,112 records).
The round-1 mechanism is confirmed removed: shared-buffer pressure stays at 0 under the tap (60-minute trace).
The round-1 'unarchivable' record is amended with the round-2 recovery; the coverage claim reopens under the new protocol and the earlier scope is retained as a correct statement about protocol v1.
